_comment: The app + domain-event allowlist. Onboarding a new app = one block here, then merge the PR: CI deploys, the per-app BigQuery tables and the all_events view self-provision on startup, and the app's API key derives from its id (see ClientKeyMap). No secrets live here. 'events' maps a domain to its event names; append ':create|update|delete' only when the name has no standard suffix. 'readback' (optional) gives the app a self-scoped read credential and lists the reports.json ids it may run.
